text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a few days before Christmas when T.M. Opera O
approached me with a "modest consultation."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, would you host a modest
Christmas party for me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gather royalty and nobility from all over the world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What, is it impossible?
Then let's lower the requirements a bit and...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Only within what you can manage, of course, but...
could you gather as many high-ranking officials as possible?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having been asked, I reluctantly agreed to take it on,
worrying whether they might act impolitely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on Christmas Day—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. So your company owns that theater.
My, how wonderful.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you're donating a cloak for me?!
I'm truly grateful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking with the various guests, T.M. Opera O
was a bit quieter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the glamorous party came to an end...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun.
That was a truly meaningful time.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With this, the guests should understand
what kind of Umamusume T.M. Opera O is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm, scheming, you say...?
choice_data_list: Because your attitude was different from usual.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, is that because it was pretty quiet?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I certainly held back, yes.
After all, if I were to speak at full throttle..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's so overwhelmingly precious, the bigwigs might get purified into nothingness,
you know? And we certainly wouldn't want any casualties.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I want humanity to get used to it gradually, you see.
To the brilliance of the Overlord of the Century's End, soon to be born!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed, humanity!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spreading both arms to the night sky,
T.M. Opera O began a grand monologue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, upon the stage of Earth, the human race
dances as its eternal leading star."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believed that position was unshakeable.
However, stepping up to it was—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The "Overlord of the Century's End," blessed with overwhelming beauty and might, is about to be born. That peerless Umamusume... is none other than me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "What do you think would happen if people in power who know nothing about it were to lay eyes on such a thing?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
99% will worship. But the remaining 1%,
due to being overwhelmingly absolute—
choice_data_list: ...Could it be that you might be scared?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is how it is. In order not to intimidate them,
I must let them know that I am not dangerous.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I was keeping quiet because I wanted to make my appeal without causing any misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone who attended the party today
has surely witnessed my brilliance,
in all its absolute glory..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"With this, 100% will become my followers,
and we can avoid pointless strife."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad. Truly, what a relief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Christmas party, which seemed like mere entertainment,
actually held T.M. Opera O's own thoughtful intentions.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd love it if everyone gathered here today
became my big spend... er, fans!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And hopefully, you'll recognize me as an Executive Athlete and sponsor me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And if I could make one more wish...
I'd love for them to build a theme park too!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
TM Operaland, and TM Opera Park!
Even Opera O Studios Japan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps there was no deeper thought behind it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun, with all that said...
You understand what you need to do, right?
choice_data_list: What do you need to do?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To build my theme parks all over the world,
getting to know more influential figures is essential.
So with that said...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: For next year's Christmas, bring me real royalty!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I won't accept any excuses. You have a duty to deliver radiance alongside me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A ruthless Christmas present...
While throwing an impossible task at me,
TM Opera O laughed with utter delight.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If you do not understand, then follow me.
We shall perform a little ritual."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the place TM Opera O
brought me to was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Listen, Trainer-kun. Today, I took a roundabout approach so you could get to know me calmly, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is a much simpler way.
A bold, audacious approach befitting the "Supreme Ruler."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that would be—
to produce the mightiest figure of authority from our own circle.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In other words,
you shall become the King of Humanity!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With your caliber, it shouldn't be impossible, right?
Just take a look at my current fan count!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Gaining this many passionate fans
is all thanks to you!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If a king of men possessing such power is united with the 'Overlord of the Century's End' among Umamusume,
the world will surely be at peace, will it not?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you, who know my radiance down to the depths of my soul,
are the representative of mankind, then this could not be simpler...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even the "Supreme King"... needs a companion, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O offered a gentle smile—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, as a proof of our vow—
won't you accept this ring?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The ring of promise
that I had been keeping warm close to my chest, that is.
choice_data_list: That ring... What kind of ring is it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That ring is the proof of an engagement
between species, the legendary...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: “Der Ring des Nibelungen”!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With the ring's magic power, you shall control humanity's will
and together we will rule the world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Come now, laugh with me!
Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without really understanding what was going on, I laughed along with her.
It was a Christmas where I saw a whole new world with T.M. Opera O.
